fields.description: URL path segment for this storefront, e.g. "flowers" for /flowers/store. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens only; cannot start with a hyphen; cannot be a word the app or site already routes on.
fields.label: Slug

fields.description: The preset name applied to this store's branding.
fields.label: Theme Preset

fields.description: Leave empty to inherit the site-wide Webstore Settings categories.
fields.label: Categories

fields.description: Leave empty to inherit the site-wide Webstore Settings guest price lists.
fields.label: Guest Price Lists (currency picker)

fields.description: Leave empty to inherit the site-wide Webstore Settings warehouses.
fields.label: Stock Warehouses

fields.description: Which checkout button(s) this store's cart page offers. Blank inherits Webstore Settings.
fields.label: Checkout Mode
fields.options:
Buyer chooses
Quotation only
Sales order only

fields.description: Box maths and the order minimum for this store. Blank inherits Webstore Settings; Disabled turns packing off for this store even when the site-wide setting is on.
fields.label: Box Packing Rules

fields.description: Seeds each new cart line for this store. Must be a usable box from this site's box source. Blank inherits Webstore Settings.
fields.label: Default Box Type

fields.description: 0 = inherit Webstore Settings. Checked against the whole cart, not per line.
fields.label: Minimum Order (Stems)

fields.description: Earliest shipping date a buyer may request, and the fallback when none is given. Blank/0 inherits Webstore Settings.
fields.label: Delivery Lead Time (Days)
